profiles.abilities: AT(2), Blast(4), Overheating, Shield Breaker(-1), Suppression(3)

profiles.name: Warpfire blaster (overcharged)
profiles.abilities: AT(2), Combi, Overheating, Shield Breaker(-1), Suppression(3)

equipment.name: Amulet of Spawndom
equipment.desc: If the model destroys an enemy character model, you can immediately place a friendly Chaos Spawn within 3" of this model. If not, you can set up a Chaos Spawn following the rules for Deep Strike in any subsequent Reinforcement Phase. When set up, the closest enemy unit within 12" immediately gains one Battleshock token. Unique.

equipment.name: Baleful icon
equipment.desc: Any unit selecting this model or its attached unit as a charge target must resolve a test for dangerous terrain.

equipment.name: Burning lore
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Psyker" ability and may cast 1 power and deny 1 power per battle round. It knows Smite, and all powers from Dark Hereticus or a chosen General discipline. Legion Praetor only.

equipment.name: Charismatic leadership
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Leadership, but loses this bonus if it ever flees.

equipment.name: Crown of the Blasphemer
equipment.desc: If the model attempts to use a prayer, the roll is automatically successful. Chaplain only. Unique.

equipment.name: The Scripts of Erebus
equipment.desc: If the model attempts to use a psychic power, the roll is automatically successful with the minimum cast value necessary. The model may choose to use the effect of this item. Unique.

equipment.name: The Skull of Monarchia
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit receive a +5 bonus to all combat results and the "Fearless" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Mhara Gal
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Daemon" and "Terrifying(-2)" abilities. Only for Walkers.

equipment.name:
Dark Brethren
(Traitor only)
equipment.desc:
- The army may take up to one Troops, Elites or Fast Attack choice from the Chaos Daemon Codex per 500 points of game size.
- The first time any unit (including attached characters) kills an enemy unit or forces one to flee from melee combat, it receives the benefits of one Mark of Chaos like a non-character model.
- Enemy psykers may be forced to re-roll their result on the Perils of the Warp table.
- Only a single Heavy Support choice may be taken in this army.
- The army must take a Legion Centurion with the Chaplain upgrade that does not take up an HQ slot.

equipment.name:
Last of the Serrated
Sun (Traitor only)
equipment.desc:
- Gal Vorbak Squads may be taken as Troops.
- Only units with the Dark Channelling upgrade or "Daemon" ability count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- The army cannot take any units with 0" Movement characteristic.
- The army must take a Legion Centurion with the Chaplain upgrade that does not take up an HQ slot.
